summary: L3Harris filed an 8-K disclosing the November 5, 2026 closing of a $1.0 billion senior notes offering split evenly between $500 million 5.200% notes due 2029 and $500 million 5.400% notes due 2032, sold under its February 12, 2026 automatic shelf registration via a November 2, 2026 prospectus supplement and underwriting agreement led by Citigroup, Scotia, U.S. Bancorp and Wells Fargo. Net proceeds target general corporate purposes, chiefly redeeming or repaying the $550 million 3.85% notes due December 15, 2026 and, with cash, a portion of the $1,250 million 5.40% notes due January 15, 2027. Watch refinancing economics and any residual 2027 notes left outstanding.
